links.outcome: Reference retrieval quality and perceived helpfulness in human evaluation of guideline-based agent answers
links.effect: Human evaluators found comprehension and completeness good, but reference retrieval and perceived helpfulness were not optimal.
links.quote: However, reference retrieval and perceived helpfulness of the CA reply was not optimal.

unlisted_practices: Restricting a GPT-4o agent to answer from 17 clinical practice guidelines via instructions
Prompt refinement to raise specificity on knowledge scales

screen.reason: The study develops a GPT-4o-based conversational agent for Alzheimer's clinical guidance and compares performance before and after modifying the input prompt given to the assistant.
